review_method: Official website review on 2026-11-11 during Phase 1 implementation. Curated discovery metadata only; no eligibility rules or application deadlines are extracted or published.

schemes.name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship for the North Eastern Region
schemes.description: UGC scholarship assistance to expand access to undergraduate education for students from India's North Eastern Region.

sources.title: National Scholarship Portal scheme directory
sources.publisher: National Scholarship Portal, Government of India
sources.verification_notes: The UGC section lists Ishan Uday. Directory presence is not an eligibility decision or application deadline guarantee.

sources.title: UGC Ishan Uday scheme overview
sources.verification_notes: UGC describes the scheme's objective as widening access to higher education for students of the North Eastern Region. Financial amounts are deliberately not stored.

sources.title: West Bengal Higher Education scholarship overview
sources.publisher: Department of Higher Education, Government of West Bengal
sources.verification_notes: The UGC scholarship section explicitly enumerates the eight North Eastern domicile states and identifies UGC under the Ministry of Education. This supports the discovery filter only. Official pages differ in financial benefit descriptions, so no amounts or executable rules are recorded.

sources.title: National Scholarship Portal scheme directory
sources.publisher: National Scholarship Portal, Government of India

sources.title: West Bengal Higher Education scholarship overview
